function: Learned active-sensing policy designs the BS analog receive combiner frame by frame during beam training, trading off UE localization CRB (position error bound) against final-slot uplink rate (p. 1, 3).
system: Single-user uplink: BS analog ULA, N=32; single-antenna UE; OFDM 2.4 GHz, 100 MHz, K=10 (and 1) subcarriers; T=8 pilots; LOS plus one reflection; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: Three-layer LSTM plus DNN head maps pilot-observation history to a unit-modulus combiner; trained offline, unsupervised on the CRB-rate objective, with a supervised MSE-to-reference-beam variant (p. 3-5).
data_channel: Own simulator: two-path geometric channel (LOS plus one reflection) with only the path loss from 3GPP TR 38.901; random UE positions, fixed wall; no measurements (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained offline, tested on different random UE locations with the same wall and BS geometry; sweeps over K, SNR and lambda; no new geometry or configuration (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: random phase beamformer, genie DFT codebooks (position-known, channel-known). Learned variants of the same network: map-free active sensing and MSE-trained comm-only policy (p. 4).
metrics: CDF of UE position error bound (PEB, from CRB), CDF of final-slot achievable rate, PEB versus rate over lambda, beampatterns (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 2: "The large-scale attenuation follows the floating-intercept (FI)" model of 3GPP TR 38.901 [14], but only the path loss is used, with a custom two-path geometry (p. 4: "a two-path scenario (L = 2)"), no 3GPP channel generator or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "and then testing in a set of different random UE locations with the wall and BS geometry as in Section II-A"; held-out UE positions in the same geometry, no new scenario, band or array size is tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "Map-free active sensing: same network architecture as Section III-B" and "Communication-only training (MSE-to-reference beam)" are variants of the proposed network; random phase and genie DFT codebooks are non-learned; no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "During inference, the BS runs a forward pass of the trained network sequentially" is the only statement on cost; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 1: "Data is available on-line at" https://github.com/xiaocaiulm/map_aided_active_sensing (footnote with link).
notes: Area 5: ISAC beam design, since the objective of Eq. (6) (p. 3) mixes the localization CRB and the uplink rate, so the function is not localization alone. The BS has N=32 antennas, so the single-antenna check does not apply. Only a one-line footnote announces the data; the repository itself was not inspected.
